stumbles.quote: Lock your phone's screen rotation to portrait before opening the link, because the game prompts you to turn the phone to landscape itself.
stumbles.why: Contradictory/confusing: with rotation locked to portrait, turning the phone to landscape won't rotate the screen, so it's unclear how the landscape prompt works or whether the game is meant to be played in landscape on a locked screen.

stumbles.quote: Then follow the prompt to turn the phone to landscape.
stumbles.why: Unclear what the prompt looks like or how it detects landscape given the portrait lock mentioned earlier.

stumbles.quote: the game zeroes the steering at the phone's current tilt
stumbles.why: Unclear what 'neutral angle' is in practice (e.g., how steep to hold it for acceleration), and whether acceleration/brake tilt is also zeroed or only steering.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top edge away from you to accelerate, and towards you to brake.
stumbles.why: In landscape the 'top edge' is ambiguous: it is unclear which edge is meant after turning the phone sideways.

point: Open the link on a motion-sensor phone with rotation locked to portrait, pick track, laps and difficulty, turn to landscape, hold a neutral angle until the lights go out, then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
